scriptLines: admission_date = case(   isNull(admission_date), toDate(null()),   instr(admission_date,',')>0, toDate(admission_date,'MMMM dd, yyyy'),   instr(admission_date,'/')>0, toDate(admission_date,'MM/dd/yyyy'),   substring(admission_date,5,1)=='-', toDate(admission_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'),   length(admission_date)==8, toDate(concat(left(admission_date,6), iif(toInteger(right(admission_date,2))<=26,'20','19'), right(admission_date,2)), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   length(admission_date)==11, toDate(admission_date,'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(null())),

discharge_date = case(   isNull(discharge_date), toDate(null()),   instr(discharge_date,',')>0, toDate(discharge_date,'MMMM dd, yyyy'),   instr(discharge_date,'/')>0, toDate(discharge_date,'MM/dd/yyyy'),   substring(discharge_date,5,1)=='-', toDate(discharge_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'),   length(discharge_date)==8, toDate(concat(left(discharge_date,6), iif(toInteger(right(discharge_date,2))<=26,'20','19'), right(discharge_date,2)), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   length(discharge_date)==11, toDate(discharge_date,'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(null()))) ~> normalizar

payment_date = case(   isNull(payment_date), toDate(null()),   instr(payment_date,',')>0, toDate(payment_date,'MMMM dd, yyyy'),   instr(payment_date,'/')>0, toDate(payment_date,'MM/dd/yyyy'),   substring(payment_date,5,1)=='-', toDate(payment_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'),   length(payment_date)==8, toDate(concat(left(payment_date,6), iif(toInteger(right(payment_date,2))<=26,'20','19'), right(payment_date,2)), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   length(payment_date)==11, toDate(payment_date,'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(null()))) ~> normalizar

date_of_birth = case(   isNull(date_of_birth), toDate(null()),   instr(date_of_birth,',')>0, toDate(date_of_birth,'MMMM dd, yyyy'),   instr(date_of_birth,'/')>0, toDate(date_of_birth,'MM/dd/yyyy'),   substring(date_of_birth,5,1)=='-', toDate(date_of_birth,'yyyy-MM-dd'),   length(date_of_birth)==8, toDate(concat(left(date_of_birth,6), iif(toInteger(right(date_of_birth,2))<=26,'20','19'), right(date_of_birth,2)), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   length(date_of_birth)==11, toDate(date_of_birth,'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(null()))) ~> normalizar

normalizar derive(phone = case(   length(phone)==10, concat(substring(phone,1,3),'-',substring(phone,4,3),'-',substring(phone,7,4)),   length(phone)==11 && left(phone,1)=='1', concat(substring(phone,2,3),'-',substring(phone,5,3),'-',substring(phone,8,4)),   toString(null())),

insurance_provider = case(   isNull(insurance_provider),'Unknown',   instr(insurance_provider,'medicaid')>0,'Medicaid',   instr(insurance_provider,'medicare')>0,'Medicare',   instr(insurance_provider,'cigna')>0,'Cigna',   instr(insurance_provider,'united')>0 || insurance_provider=='uhc','UnitedHealthcare',   instr(insurance_provider,'blue')>0,'Blue Cross',   instr(insurance_provider,'aetna')>0,'Aetna',   instr(insurance_provider,'self')>0,'Self-Pay',   'Unknown'),
date_of_birth = iif(date_of_birth>currentDate() || date_of_birth<toDate('1900-01-01'), toDate(null()), date_of_birth)) ~> reglas
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT department AS nombre_departamento\nFROM silver.admissions',
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT charge_type AS tipo_cargo, payment_status AS estado_pago\nFROM silver.billing',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT icd_code AS codigo_icd, severity AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.diagnoses
UNION
SELECT 'N/A', 'Unknown'',

query: 'SELECT
    t.patient_id AS patient_id_bk,
    t.full_name AS nombre_completo,
    CASE t.gender WHEN 'Male' THEN 'Masculino'
                  WHEN 'Female' THEN 'Femenino'
                  ELSE 'Otro' END AS genero,
    t.date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,
    CASE WHEN t.edad IS NULL THEN NULL
         WHEN t.edad <= 18 THEN '0-18'
         WHEN t.edad <= 35 THEN '19-35'
         WHEN t.edad <= 60 THEN '36-60'
         ELSE '60+' END AS rango_etario,
    t.email AS correo_electronico,
    t.address AS direccion,
    COALESCE(t.insurance_provider, 'Unknown') AS proveedor_seguro
FROM (
    SELECT p.*,
           CASE WHEN p.date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE DATEDIFF(YEAR, p.date_of_birth, GETDATE())
                     - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, p.date_of_birth, GETDATE()), p.date_of_birth) > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
                            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           END AS edad
    FROM silver.patients p
) t',

query: 'SELECT
    CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), f.fecha, 112)) AS fecha_key,
    f.fecha AS fecha_completa,
    YEAR(f.fecha) AS anio,
    DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha) AS trimestre,
    'T' + CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha) AS VARCHAR(1)) AS trimestre_nombre,
    MONTH(f.fecha) AS mes,
    CHOOSE(MONTH(f.fecha), 'Enero','Febrero','Marzo','Abril','Mayo','Junio','Julio','Agosto','Septiembre','Octubre','Noviembre','Diciembre') AS mes_nombre,
    CHOOSE(MONTH(f.fecha), 'Ene','Feb','Mar','Abr','May','Jun','Jul','Ago','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dic') AS mes_corto,
    DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, f.fecha) AS semana_anio,
    DAY(f.fecha) AS dia_mes,
    ds.dia_semana AS dia_semana,
    CHOOSE(ds.dia_semana, 'Lunes','Martes','Miércoles','Jueves','Viernes','Sábado','Domingo') AS dia_nombre,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ds.dia_semana IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions
    UNION
    SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions
    UNION
    SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing
) f
CROSS APPLY (SELECT (DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', f.fecha) % 7) + 1 AS dia_semana) ds
WHERE f.fecha IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    d.departamento_key,
    g.diagnostico_key,
    CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112)) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112)) END AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) END AS dias_estancia
FROM silver.admissions a
JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
     ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
JOIN gold.dim_departamento d
     ON d.nombre_departamento = a.department
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT admission_id, icd_code, severity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY admission_id ORDER BY diagnosis_id, icd_code) AS rn
    FROM silver.diagnoses
) dx ON dx.admission_id = a.admission_id AND dx.rn = 1
JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico g
     ON g.codigo_icd = COALESCE(dx.icd_code, 'N/A')
    AND g.nivel_severidad = COALESCE(dx.severity, 'Unknown')',

query: 'SELECT
    b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk,
    b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    d.departamento_key,
    s.servicio_cargo_key,
    CASE WHEN b.payment_date IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), b.payment_date, 112)) END AS fecha_pago_key,
    b.amount AS monto_facturado
FROM silver.billing b
JOIN silver.admissions a
     ON a.admission_id = b.admission_id
JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
     ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
JOIN gold.dim_departamento d
     ON d.nombre_departamento = a.department
JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo s
     ON s.tipo_cargo = b.charge_type
    AND s.estado_pago = b.payment_status',
